.github/workflows/ci.yml.predecessor_utf8:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

# Concurrency is per-JOB: a newer push to the same PR or branch cancels that
# ref's in-flight `checks` and `e2e`. Both are safe to cancel — `e2e` runs
# against its own throwaway Supabase, so nothing is left dirty.
#
# `checks` and `e2e` run side by side (both start as soon as `changes` says the
# diff touches the app), so a push takes as long as the slower of the two, not
# their sum. Measured on a passing run: checks ~2m20s, e2e ~6m55s; in series
# that was ~9m40s from push to green. The cost is that a lint or type error no
# longer stops e2e before it starts, so a push with one wastes that e2e run.

jobs:
  # Docs-only changes (docs/, pitch/, mockups/, prototypes/, Markdown outside
  # content/) skip the ~10 runner-minute checks + E2E run. The jobs are skipped
  # with `if:`, not filtered with `paths-ignore`, so they still report their
  # check names (as "skipped", which satisfies a required status check) and a
  # docs-only PR can merge. Anything else, or any doubt (a diff that can't be
  # computed), runs everything. content/ always counts: the app imports its
  # JSON and the unit tests read its Markdown.
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      app: ${{ steps.diff.outputs.app }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Check this draft's exact head; other branches keep their standard checkout.
          ref: ${{ (github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-151-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-152-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-154-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-156-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-161-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-162-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-163-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-164-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-165-enhancement-handoff') && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - id: diff
        env:
          # pull_request checks out the PR's merge commit, whose first parent
          # is this base SHA, so the diff is exactly what the PR changes.
          BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
        run: |
          set -u
          app=true
          if git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin "$BASE" 2>/dev/null \
            && changed=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD) && [ -n "$changed" ]; then
            app=false
            while IFS= read -r f; do
              case "$f" in
                content/*) app=true ;;
                docs/*|pitch/*|mockups/*|prototypes/*|.claude/*|.agents/*|*.md) ;;
                *) app=true ;;
              esac
            done <<< "$changed"
            echo "Changed files:"; echo "$changed"
          fi
          echo "app=$app" | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # Pure local checks: fully parallel across PRs, fast feedback.
  checks:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: checks-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Check this draft's exact head; other branches keep their standard checkout.
          ref: ${{ (github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-151-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-152-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-154-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-156-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-161-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-162-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-163-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-164-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-165-enhancement-handoff') && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Validate Gabay course source
        run: npm run gabay:check

      - name: Validate Gabay KB source
        run: npm run gabay:kb:check

      - name: Verify approved Gabay release package
        run: npm run gabay:release:check

      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm run test

  e2e:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Each run gets its OWN throwaway Supabase, built by `supabase start` from
    # supabase/migrations/ and seeded by supabase/seed.sql (the four stable
    # fixture accounts plus the pilot's resting feature flags). Nothing here
    # touches the pilot project any more: E2E used to write into it on every
    # PR, and the specs, their purges and the flag flips were a large share of
    # the pilot's Disk IO budget on the free plan — see docs/deploy-runbook.md's
    # "E2E database" section.
    #
    # Because nothing is shared, runs can overlap and a cancelled run leaves
    # nothing behind, so this job is cancellable like `checks` and needs no
    # queueing (the old e2e-wait job and e2e-shared-supabase-project group).
    concurrency:
      group: e2e-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    env:
      # The local stack's well-known demo URL, anon key and the seed's fixture
      # password. None of these are secrets: they only ever unlock the
      # throwaway database this job starts and discards.
      NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:54321
      NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZS1kZW1vIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJleHAiOjE5ODM4MTI5OTZ9.CRXP1A7WOeoJeXxjNni43kdQwgnWNReilDMblYTn_I0
      E2E_STABLE_BHW_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password
      E2E_STABLE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password
      E2E_OTHER_BARANGAY_BHW_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password
      E2E_STABLE_CITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password
      E2E_STABLE_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password
      # The seed turns ai_external + ai_gap_draft on, as on the pilot, so
      # e2e/ai-gap-draft.spec.ts runs its real round trip and needs a provider
      # key; each run spends a small amount of Gemini quota. GEMINI_MODEL is
      # optional.
      GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
      GEMINI_MODEL: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_MODEL }}
      SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
      SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
      SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
      SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Check this draft's exact head; other branches keep their standard checkout.
          ref: ${{ (github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-151-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-152-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-154-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-156-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-161-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-162-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-163-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-164-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-165-enhancement-handoff') && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1
        with:
          version: 2.118.0

      # Chromium for Playwright. A cache hit skips the ~150 MB download; the
      # install command below still runs to add the system packages.
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}

      # The three slowest setup steps need nothing from each other, so they run
      # together instead of one after another (~65s Supabase start, ~41s build,
      # ~26s browser install, ~2m10s in series). The build does not need the
      # database: no route is statically generated. Only what the app and specs
      # call is started: Postgres, Auth, PostgREST, Storage and the Kong
      # gateway in front of them. Background output is held in log files and
      # printed in groups after, so it stays readable and a failure shows its log.
      - name: Start local Supabase, build the app and install browsers (in parallel)
        run: |
          npm run build > build.log 2>&1 &
          build_pid=$!
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium > playwright.log 2>&1 &
          playwright_pid=$!

          status=0
          supabase start -x realtime,imgproxy,mailpit,postgres-meta,studio,edge-runtime,logflare,vector,supavisor || status=1
          wait "$build_pid" || { echo "::error::build failed"; status=1; }
          wait "$playwright_pid" || { echo "::error::playwright install failed"; status=1; }

          echo "::group::npm run build"; cat build.log; echo "::endgroup::"
          echo "::group::playwright install"; cat playwright.log; echo "::endgroup::"
          exit "$status"

      # The HHP-NCD corpus the Chat Guide specs answer from, loaded and
      # published through the admin RPCs exactly as it was on the pilot.
      - name: Load KB content into local Supabase
        run: npm run kb:load -- --project local --apply --publish --owner admin.stable
        env:
          KB_LOADER_USERNAME: admin.stable
          KB_LOADER_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password

      # P4 content is published only in this job's disposable database, so
      # browser tests can verify the Chat Guide end to end. The loader rejects
      # every nonlocal target for this corpus.
      - name: Load Gabay KB into disposable Supabase
        run: npm run kb:load -- --project local --corpus philhealth-gabay --apply --publish --owner admin.stable
        env:
          KB_LOADER_USERNAME: admin.stable
          KB_LOADER_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password

      - name: Load Gabay course as a local draft
        run: npm run gabay:load -- --apply --project local --org-unit "Batong Malake" --owner admin.stable
        env:
          KB_LOADER_USERNAME: admin.stable
          KB_LOADER_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password

      - name: Rehearse Gabay course publication in disposable Supabase
        run: npm run gabay:publish -- --apply --project local --org-unit "Batong Malake" --owner admin.stable
        env:
          KB_LOADER_USERNAME: admin.stable
          KB_LOADER_PASSWORD: local-e2e-password

      - name: E2E smoke tests
        run: npm run e2e
        env:
          CI: true
          # The suite runs serially as a few shared test users, so specs that
          # each send chat requests starve one another at the default 20/min.
          # chat-guide.spec.ts reads this to size its 429 flood.
          CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE: 60

      - name: Upload Playwright traces
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-test-results
          path: test-results/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      # ~70s, so it runs on pushes to main (after merge) rather than on every
      # PR push: a performance-budget regression is caught right after it merges
      # instead of before. Re-enable it for PRs by dropping this condition.
      - name: Performance budget check (Lighthouse)
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: npx lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.js

.github/workflows/remotion.yml.predecessor_utf8:
name: Remotion clips

# INC-28 tier 2 (docs/training-modules-plan.md). Proves every committed
# composition in remotion/ still lints, typechecks and renders to the lesson
# format (480p H.264 + last-frame poster) within the size budget, and keeps
# the render as a downloadable artifact for review. It does NOT replace the
# committed files under public/training/: renders are not byte-reproducible
# across machines, so a lesson's hashed clip is re-rendered locally with
# `npm run remotion:render -- <id> <name> --public <dir>` and committed with
# its new lesson.json hashes, like every other training asset.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "remotion/**"
      - "scripts/remotion-render.mjs"
      - "scripts/lesson-161-*.mjs"
      - "scripts/lesson-162-*"
      - "docs/lesson-162-*"
      - "scripts/lesson-163-*.mjs"
      - ".github/workflows/lesson163-media.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/remotion.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "remotion/**"
      - "scripts/remotion-render.mjs"
      - "scripts/lesson-161-*.mjs"
      - "scripts/lesson-162-*"
      - "docs/lesson-162-*"
      - "scripts/lesson-163-*.mjs"
      - ".github/workflows/lesson163-media.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/remotion.yml"

concurrency:
  group: remotion-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  render:
    # Split the growing library across four runners. At 46 compositions,
    # two runners completed every clip but hit 30 minutes during upload.
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Preserve every clip, poster, size-budget check and downloadable artifact.
    # Four shards leave room for packaging as new lesson languages are added.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Check this draft's exact head; other branches keep their standard checkout.
          ref: ${{ (github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-151-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-152-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-154-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-156-malou-proposal' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-161-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-162-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-163-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-164-enhancement-handoff' || github.head_ref == 'codex/lesson-165-enhancement-handoff') && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: remotion/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Remotion project
        working-directory: remotion
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint and typecheck
        working-directory: remotion
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Install Remotion's headless browser
        working-directory: remotion
        run: npx remotion browser ensure

      - name: Render every composition
        env:
          RENDER_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # `--quiet` ends with the IDs space-separated on one line; split
          # that line and keep only ID-shaped words.
          ids=$(cd remotion && npx remotion compositions --quiet | tail -n 1 | tr -s ' \t' '\n' | grep -E '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$')
          index=0
          for id in $ids; do
            if [ "$((index % 4))" -eq "$RENDER_SHARD" ]; then
              node scripts/remotion-render.mjs "$id" 2>&1 | tee -a render.log
            fi
            index=$((index + 1))
          done
          if grep -q "warn .* exceeds" render.log; then
            echo "::error::A clip exceeds the INC-28 size budget (see log above)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: remotion-renders-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: remotion/out/
          retention-days: 14

content/training/day1-basic-competencies.predecessor_utf8:
## [purpose] Purpose

Build a cause map with two possible branches and verification steps, without treating five questions alone as proof.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

50 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 3 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare missed-visit cards and cause-map paper. Read the separate Rosario case; do not turn medicines in the historical story into medical advice.

## [opening] Opening

At the fifth “why,” the group says the mother lacks knowledge. What next?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The second response tests the explanation before acting. The question count is not proof. A lecture may miss transport, income or service gaps.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Treats a blaming explanation as proven because five questions were asked. Five Whys structures inquiry with others; evidence supports the proposed causes.

## [practice] Practice activity

Put the missed visit at the center of a page. Draw childcare and transport-cost branches. Mark each cause reported, verified or to check. Name a person to consult or record to check on each branch. Ask a partner to identify one unsupported arrow. Alone, circle it and write a verification question. Bring the resident’s perspective to the next case discussion.

## [answer-key] Answer key

2. Check the evidence and other barriers with the family and health team.

The second response tests the explanation before acting. The question count is not proof. A lecture may miss transport, income or service gaps.

## [observe] Observe

Maps two branches, separates evidence from hypotheses, gives a verification step for each and includes the resident’s perspective.

Ready: Maps two branches, separates evidence from hypotheses, gives a verification step for each and includes the resident’s perspective. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Draws two branches without verification; prompt for the person or record behind each arrow.

Not yet: Treats a blaming explanation as proven because five questions were asked.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Draws two branches without verification; prompt for the person or record behind each arrow. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21; ZFF Rosario case — repository transcription with provenance and printed workbook pages 48–51 (https://github.com/jongsky25/BHW-Connect-Phase-2/blob/6c5e05ab16c0290072c6c67e6ed8ad56436b76b3/docs/source-material/day1-basic-competencies/kwento-ni-rosario.md). The source table is an image; this draft inherits the earlier implementation plan’s verified interpretation. Rosario is a separate ZFF case source. The historical account is not clinical advice. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

## [purpose] Layunin

Gumawa ng cause map na may dalawang posibleng sangay at paraan ng pagberipika, nang hindi itinuturing na patunay ang limang tanong lamang.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

50 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 3 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang missed-visit cards at cause-map paper. Basahin ang hiwalay na Rosario case; huwag gawing medical advice ang gamot sa lumang kuwento.

## [opening] Pambungad

Sa ikalimang “bakit,” sinabi ng grupo na kulang sa kaalaman ang ina. Ano ang susunod?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang ikalawang sagot ay sumusubok sa paliwanag bago kumilos. Hindi patunay ang bilang ng tanong. Ang lecture ay maaaring hindi tumugon sa transportasyon, kita o kakulangan sa serbisyo.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Isang mapanising dahilan ang itinuturing na tiyak dahil umabot sa limang tanong. Ang Five Whys ay paraan ng pagtatanong kasama ang iba; ang ebidensya ang nagpapatibay sa sanhi.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Ilagay ang missed visit sa gitna ng papel. Gumawa ng dalawang sangay: childcare at pamasahe. Markahan ang bawat sanhi ng “sinabi,” “natiyak” o “susuriin.” Magtalaga ng taong kakausapin o rekord na susuriin sa bawat sangay. Ipasuri sa kapareha ang isang arrow na walang ebidensya. Kung mag-isa, bilugan ito at isulat ang tanong sa beripikasyon. Sa susunod na case discussion, dalhin ang pananaw ng residente.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

2. Suriin ang ebidensya at ibang hadlang kasama ang pamilya at health team.

Ang ikalawang sagot ay sumusubok sa paliwanag bago kumilos. Hindi patunay ang bilang ng tanong. Ang lecture ay maaaring hindi tumugon sa transportasyon, kita o kakulangan sa serbisyo.

## [observe] Obserbahan

May dalawang sangay ang map; magkahiwalay ang natiyak at hinala; bawat sangay ay may paraan ng beripikasyon; kasama ang pananaw ng residente.

Kaya na: May dalawang sangay ang map; magkahiwalay ang natiyak at hinala; bawat sangay ay may paraan ng beripikasyon; kasama ang pananaw ng residente. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: May dalawang sangay ngunit walang beripikasyon; ipatukoy ang kausap o rekord para sa bawat arrow.

Hindi pa: Isang mapanising dahilan ang itinuturing na tiyak dahil umabot sa limang tanong.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

May dalawang sangay ngunit walang beripikasyon; ipatukoy ang kausap o rekord para sa bawat arrow. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21; ZFF Rosario case — repository transcription with provenance and printed workbook pages 48–51 (https://github.com/jongsky25/BHW-Connect-Phase-2/blob/6c5e05ab16c0290072c6c67e6ed8ad56436b76b3/docs/source-material/day1-basic-competencies/kwento-ni-rosario.md). Ang source table ay larawan; minana ang beripikadong interpretasyon ng naunang implementation plan. Ang Rosario case ay hiwalay na ZFF source. Hindi clinical advice ang kasaysayan. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.

## [whys] Every why needs evidence

Nestor, 41, is investigating missed visits by three example households. He consults residents and health-center staff before recommending changes.

Ask why the visit was missed, then why the reported reason arose. In this fictional example, childcare was unavailable; the schedule overlapped work; only one time was communicated; household availability had not been checked. These are possible explanations to confirm with residents, BHWs and health-center staff. Reaching exactly five whys is not the goal. Reach an actionable cause supported by evidence; follow separate branches when there is more than one cause.

## [manual-example] The manual’s diarrhoea example

The Reference Manual uses a child’s diarrhoea death to investigate connected barriers to care and safe water. In the deck’s sample ranking, gaps in BHW training and teaching safe drinking-water preparation rank highly. This does not make training the cause of every death. Check explanations against evidence; poverty, transport and service gaps may also contribute. The example examines a system, not treatment instructions.

## [rosario] Rosario is a child

In the Zuellig Family Foundation case study, Rosario is a child aged one year and four months. Her death is linked to measles with diarrhoea, dehydration and malnutrition amid an unsafe environment, low income, misinformation and barriers to services. Draw separate branches for environment, livelihood and health services. Do not blame the mother alone or turn medicines mentioned in the historical story into current medical advice.

## [practice] Try it, then repeat

Put the missed visit at the center of a page. Draw childcare and transport-cost branches. Mark each cause reported, verified or to check. Name a person to consult or record to check on each branch. Ask a partner to identify one unsupported arrow. Alone, circle it and write a verification question. Bring the resident’s perspective to the next case discussion.

## [check] Choose the next step

Choose an answer and explain why before viewing the feedback. Then compare it with your own practice attempt.

## [whys] Bawat bakit, may batayan

Si Nestor, 41, ay nagsisiyasat sa missed visits ng tatlong pamilya sa halimbawa. Nakikipag-usap siya sa mga residente at health-center staff bago magmungkahi.

Tanungin kung bakit hindi nakarating, saka kung bakit nangyari ang ibinigay na dahilan. Sa kathang-isip na halimbawa, walang magbabantay sa anak; kasabay ng pagpasok sa trabaho ang schedule; iisang oras lang ang naipabatid; hindi nasuri ang kakayahang dumalo ng pamilya. Mga posibleng paliwanag ito na dapat kumpirmahin kasama ang residente, BHW at health-center staff. Hindi paligsahan ang pag-abot sa eksaktong limang bakit. Huminto sa isang nasusuring sanhi; kung may dalawang dahilan, sundan ang dalawang sanga.

## [manual-example] Ang halimbawa ng batang nagtatae

Sa Reference Manual, ang pagkamatay ng batang nagtatae ay ginagamit upang siyasatin ang magkakaugnay na hadlang sa pangangalaga at ligtas na tubig. Sa halimbawang talahanayan ng deck, nauuna ang kakulangan sa BHW training at pagtuturo ng wastong paghahanda ng inuming tubig. Hindi ibig sabihing training ang sanhi ng bawat pagkamatay. Tiyaking tugma ang paliwanag sa ebidensya; maaaring kasabay ang kahirapan, transportasyon at kakulangan sa serbisyo. Ang halimbawa ay para sa pagsusuri ng sistema, hindi gabay sa paggamot.

## [rosario] Si Rosario ay isang bata

Sa case study ng Zuellig Family Foundation, si Rosario ay batang isang taon at apat na buwan. Ang kanyang pagkamatay ay iniuugnay sa tigdas na may pagtatae, dehydration at malnutrition, sa konteksto ng maruming kapaligiran, kakulangan sa kita, maling impormasyon at hadlang sa serbisyo. Gumuhit ng magkakahiwalay na sanga para sa kapaligiran, kabuhayan at serbisyong pangkalusugan. Huwag sisihin lamang ang ina o gawing payong medikal ngayon ang mga gamot na nabanggit sa lumang kuwento.

## [practice] Subukan, saka ulitin

Ilagay ang missed visit sa gitna ng papel. Gumawa ng dalawang sangay: childcare at pamasahe. Markahan ang bawat sanhi ng “sinabi,” “natiyak” o “susuriin.” Magtalaga ng taong kakausapin o rekord na susuriin sa bawat sangay. Ipasuri sa kapareha ang isang arrow na walang ebidensya. Kung mag-isa, bilugan ito at isulat ang tanong sa beripikasyon. Sa susunod na case discussion, dalhin ang pananaw ng residente.

## [check] Piliin ang susunod na hakbang

Piliin ang sagot at ipaliwanag kung bakit bago tingnan ang feedback. Pagkatapos, ihambing sa sarili mong ginawa sa pagsasanay.
